title: Chloride–total CO2 joint encoding: an exploratory independent-cycle renal-marker transfer test
abstract: In exploratory NHANES2009–2010 to2015–2016 transfer, adding chloride–totalCO2 tensor splines changed weighted log-UACR MSE from 0.809218 to 1.569427, delta +0.760208 (joint PSU-bootstrap95% [+0.119734,+202.079353]). The registered improvement criterion failed. This is a representation test, not evidence of a new clinical marker. Exploratory transfer, not untouched confirmation.
